notes: New map: the Castle, a dark stone fortress with its own heavy-metal music. Pick it on the class screen.
The Safe Haven: a portal takes you to a mob-free town with every shop. You are sent back out after 30 seconds.
Every class gets 2 extra skills (Druid forms too) and one more skill slot, so you can now carry 6.
The Summoner has an auto attack and more summons.
Each race now has its own cat form for the Druid.
New passives to pick on level-up.
The Armory is now a branching talent tree with ranks, tiers and capstones, and you can reset it for a full refund.
Balance: XP pickups are smaller and XP shrinks further after minute 8.
